blocks.title: أمثلة
blocks.html:
I'm selling my second-hand bike. It's in good condition.
We queued for an hour, but the tickets were sold out.
I have to do chores before I can play.
My hobby is calligraphy.
If we didn't have electricity, life would be difficult.
